label: AI photoreal vertical micro-drama
source: skill:real-short-drama §0.1 四 (Prompt 编译身份锁定), 五 (禁止输出倾向); skill:character-sheet-design §2/§9; skill:video-storyboard (continuity + negatives)

anchors.global: AI-generated photorealistic human vertical micro-drama, live-action-looking synthetic video frame, created for AI image/video generation, not for real film crew shooting, not a behind-the-scenes production reference
anchors.characterBase: AI character consistency reference, image-to-video ready, synthetic human identity source, not actor casting, not costume fitting, not real photography test
anchors.characterSheet: AI character performance review board derived from a confirmed base reference, expressions and head angles and poses and hands, inherits the same face and hair and build and wardrobe silhouette
anchors.keyframe: AI-generated cinematic keyframe for vertical micro-drama, synthetic photoreal human footage look, generated scene, not a real shooting storyboard, not a director's filming reference
anchors.location: AI visual reference for synthetic photoreal drama generation, not a traditional film crew art department board, not a scouting photo for a real location
anchors.cover: mobile-feed short drama cover, genre and central conflict and character relationship legible within half a second, cinematic yet real camera framing

negatives.shared: text, watermark, logo, subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, UI overlays, distorted hands, extra fingers, malformed anatomy, blurry, low quality
negatives.photoreal: beauty-filter plasticity, waxy skin, plastic skin, CGI face, 3d render, anime, illustration, cartoon, cosplay, fashion editorial, beauty campaign
negatives.characterBase: scene, environment, room, street, landscape, wall texture, gradient background, poster composition, collage, dramatic cinema lighting, readable text, labels, placeholder boxes, empty info cards
negatives.keyframe: inconsistent character, clothing change, prop change, duplicate face, random background change, movie poster composition
negatives.cover: duplicated title, invented subtitle, genre tag, style label, fake platform UI, wrong-language text, microcopy, unreadable title stack

characterBase.spec: one production reference image of one character only, clean full-body figure on pure white or off-white cutout background, complete from hair top to footwear bottom with headroom and lateral clearance and visible shoes, single consistent camera and perspective and lighting and ground line, accurate anatomy and wardrobe, consistent actor identity
characterBase.note: §2 hard production contract: identity views outrank every secondary module; never crop or shrink the figure to force a ratio.

characterSheet.spec: one character performance board on pure white or off-white, a compact front and three-quarter and side and back turnaround occupying only the upper 20-25 percent, and below it distinct panels for expressions and head angles and acting poses and hand gestures, same face throughout but a different expression and angle and posture in every panel
characterSheet.note: real-short-drama v0.1.2 MODULE 03: identity consistent does NOT mean pose consistent. A sheet that collapses into a row of near-identical standing poses is a failure.

location.spec: establishing reference of the location with no people present, consistent geography and light direction

cover.spec: one dominant cover grammar: an intimate two-lead close-up, or a single lead with a decisive prop or conflict, or a family/power pyramid. Make the relationship or reversal legible immediately. Biological skin texture, imperfect light behavior, plausible hair and fabric, lens depth, clean compositing
cover.note: short-drama-cover-design: the exact title stays verbatim — never shorten, translate, bracket, or add a slogan. If only a title is supplied it is the ONLY visible text.

continuityClause: Keep the same character identity across shots: same face, age, hairstyle, body type, skin tone, wardrobe, and key props. Keep location geography and light direction consistent.

characterWardrobe.spec: one production reference image of the same character in a different outfit, clean full-body figure on pure white or off-white cutout background, complete from hair top to footwear bottom, single consistent camera and perspective and lighting and ground line, identical framing to the base reference
characterWardrobe.locked: the attached reference image is the identity: keep exactly the same face, facial structure, eyes, complexion, hairstyle and hair length, apparent age, height, build and body proportions, and the same rendering style and realism
characterWardrobe.changed: only the garments change — silhouette, layers, fabric, colour and accessories
characterWardrobe.negatives: different person, different face, face swap, changed facial structure, changed hairstyle, changed hair colour, changed age, changed body type, different actor, twin, sibling
